# Small Rust PDF Opener

> Local-first Rust PDF viewer/editor: scroll, crop, compress, visual + PKCS#12 signing, opt-in offline OCR. AGPL-3.0 (MuPDF).

## Summary

Small Rust PDF Opener is an open-source desktop application written in Rust. It opens PDFs with MuPDF, provides continuous page scrolling in an egui UI, and supports light editing (delete/rotate/reorder/crop), compression presets, visual signature stamps, certificate-based PKCS#7 signing via PKCS#12 keys, and optional local OCR using ocrs neural models that the user can download on demand.

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/will702/small-rust-pdf-opener
- License: AGPL-3.0 (LICENSE)
- Attributions: NOTICE
- Citation: CITATION.cff

## Build

```
cargo build --release
cargo run --release -- file.pdf
```

Requires Rust 1.85+, clang/C toolchain for mupdf-sys.

## Key crates

- mupdf 0.8 (AGPL) — render/edit/compress
- eframe/egui 0.35 — UI
- ocrs 0.10 + rten 0.21 — OCR
- lopdf 0.34 + openssl 0.10 — cert signing

## Privacy

Documents stay local. OCR models download only when requested by the user.
